question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        strftime(CAST(txn_date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE strftime(CAST(txn_date AS DATE), '%Y') = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, strftime(CAST(txn_date AS DATE), '%Y-%m')
),
positive_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(*) AS positive_count
    FROM monthly_balances
    WHERE month_end_balance > 0
    GROUP BY month
),
max_min_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) AS rank_highest,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) AS rank_lowest
    FROM positive_counts
),
highest_month AS (
    SELECT month FROM max_min_months WHERE rank_highest = 1
),
lowest_month AS (
    SELECT month FROM max_min_months WHERE rank_lowest = 1
),
monthly_avg_all AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(month_end_balance) AS avg_month_end_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
    hm.month AS highest_month,
    lm.month AS lowest_month,
    ha.avg_month_end_balance AS highest_avg,
    la.avg_month_end_balance AS lowest_avg,
    ha.avg_month_end_balance - la.avg_month_end_balance AS difference
FROM highest_month hm
CROSS JOIN lowest_month lm
JOIN monthly_avg_all ha ON ha.month = hm.month
JOIN monthly_avg_all la ON la.month = lm.month
